review.sentinelone.faq.a1: SentinelOne's unique Rollback feature can automatically reverse ransomware encryption by restoring affected files to their pre-attack state. This happens automatically when ransomware is detected, minimizing data loss and downtime.
review.sentinelone.faq.a2: Purple AI is SentinelOne's generative AI security analyst that helps teams investigate threats, hunt for IOCs, and analyze incidents using natural language. It combines offensive and defensive security knowledge (red team + blue team = purple).
review.sentinelone.faq.q3: How does SentinelOne compare to CrowdStrike?
review.sentinelone.faq.a3: Both are top-tier EDR solutions. SentinelOne typically costs 20-30% less and offers better automation/rollback. CrowdStrike has deeper threat intelligence and more mature ecosystem. Choice depends on priorities and budget.
review.sentinelone.faq.q4: Does SentinelOne support Linux and Mac?
review.sentinelone.faq.a4: Yes. SentinelOne provides full protection for Windows, macOS, Linux, and supports containers and cloud workloads. All platforms managed from a single console with consistent capabilities.
review.sentinelone.faq.q5: Is SentinelOne suitable for small businesses?
review.sentinelone.faq.a5: Yes, especially those with limited security staff. The autonomous capabilities and automation reduce the need for dedicated security analysts. Pricing becomes cost-effective around 50-100 endpoints.
